body.headline: Consider moving your car to higher ground before heavy rain
body.detail: Flood records or an active alert flag this spot. Higher ground is not a guarantee of safety.

reasons.text: This spot is inside the mapped Hurricane Harvey flood extent

body.limits: Based on flood records and maps, not a prediction for this storm. It cannot tell you a spot is safe. Call 911 in an emergency.
